answerPolicyA: every BLOCKING question answered with: the option the tool marks as its leaning; else the option it costs until answered; else (route only) the route the server is already costing as placeholder; else the first option offered. Advisory questions left at the tool's costed default. Route-matched "@sheet" variants: the route is a stated engineering assumption (sheet_metal) in BOTH A and C.
reviewPolicyC: from the independent truth file: a drawing reading equal to a truth row (scorer rowAccepts) is confirmed; a scalar reading whose parameter the truth gives ONE value for is corrected to it; any other reading in a group the truth lists as complete is rejected (not on the drawing); readings in groups the truth does not list completely are left unreviewed; an interpreted value is confirmed once its source is confirmed/corrected (checked by hand: one stale interpretation rejected, see manual-review.json); conflicts settled to the side equal to the truth. Other blocking questions answered as in A (same id) unless the drawing answers them. Note: on the screen only readings outside the "not in the cost model" list can be decided — the API accepts decisions on all.

findings.materialConfirmed: On 8 of the 13 rows the reviewer confirmed a correct material reading (designation equal to the truth, then the interpreted family). It answered material.family on 7 costed rows (D2MI 906, bed plate, corner bracket, OpenEAI 01-02, FTC-09, corner bracket @sheet, chassis @sheet) and, on the chassis @sheet, material.grade = AA5052-H32 Sheet. Each of these C totals equals the before run's C-hand total (the engineer typing the family by hand), except the chassis @sheet: £19.9137 v £20.2170, because the drawing now also answers the grade (AA5052-H32) where the hand answer left the default AA5754-H22.
findings.gradeNotCarried: On the machining route only the FAMILY is answered: 6061-T6, 5052 H-32 and 6061 are costed as the representative 6082-T6 bar; "304 SST" as EN8 / 080M40 medium-carbon steel (the stated stainless grade is not costed — the panel says so: "the grade it names is not costed — the machining route has no grade question"). On sheet metal, "5052 H32 AL" maps to AA5052-H32 Sheet but "5052 H-32 Aluminum" (corner bracket) maps to no grade, so the advisory grade question stays at the costed default AA5754-H22.
findings.ppPrefixEffectOnA: None. The LulzBot files (bed_plate_v4.5_PP-MP0108.step, corner_bracket_v2.0_PP-MP0106.step) still pre-answer material.family = plastic (spec source "answered", POM-C) at HEAD: A £17.2984 and £3.4967, identical before and after. With the drawing confirmed, C overrides it (the confirmed drawing reading outranks the file-name family, by design).
